properties.name: A line of reasoning reads back; objections contest until established; Decision status contested
properties.rationale:
Anthony settled the two choices at the start of the work (dec:an-objection-counts-as-far-as-it-holds, dec:contested-by-design-is-a-decision-status). The requirement needs an argument for and against to keep both sides with no verdict, which B's any-objection-refutes rule made impossible, and needs the counts not to read a dispute held open on purpose as unfinished work. Checks run locally before the push:
- the full reflow2-core in_memory suite (1916 passed) and the full reflow2-mcp in_memory suite (822 passed once the regenerated toolsnaps were read);
- skill_lint, toolsnap, render_skills_and_tools, changelog fragments, the served surface's PII check, titles, command surface, doc versions, replies_are_bounded, tool_confusability, vocabulary_reach, and the empty, refusal and smoke checks.

Ratchets moved deliberately:
- edge_readers: heal.rs::resolving_decision's GOVERNED_BY read moved into common_governor, judged not_derived, so UNJUDGED_AT_MOST went from 127 to 126;
- find_tools_rank_baseline: the acknowledge_gap/gap_to_prompt pair came apart once the new description entered the corpus.

Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019Xbw6PG9mXJiU2Sb421fnq
properties.subject: system
properties.summary: Requirement A's engine half. reasoning_report (new, read-only) reads a line of reasoning back: each claim's computed truth, its steps with their warrants and confirmations, its objections and how each stands (refutes, stands, answered), and its cited sources. It then lists what the reasoning rests on and which premises cite no source, the points still contested, the disputes contested by design, every claim with no support, and what its checks mean. It is bounded by budget_chars. An opposing CONTRADICTS now counts as far as the objection holds: it refutes when it holds, contests while unknown (proof status `contested`), and stops counting once answered; a circle of objections reads unknown. Decision.status gains `contested`, which settles intent and is not debt; detect_defects counts a contradiction between two nodes it governs as held open. Also a changelog fragment for #760, which shipped without one.
